title: @jacquelinerabe Flagship Universities, like all land grant universities, aren't built to serve the poor....if they were they wouldn't have been built
summary: @jacquelinerabe Flagship Universities, like all land grant universities, aren't built to serve the poor....if they were they wouldn't have been built in places where no people of color live. They are designed to reinforce not tackle inequity. #realcollege
author: Greg McVerry
